title: London- and Paris-based tokenized cash startup Spiko raised a $90M Series B at an $800M valuation, taking its total funding to $120M, and hits ~$2.7B in AUM (Ryan Weeks/Bloomberg)
summary: Ryan Weeks / Bloomberg: London- and Paris-based tokenized cash startup Spiko raised a $90M Series B at an $800M valuation, taking its total funding to $120M, and hits ~$2.7B in AUM — A European startup building tokenized cash funds has raised $90 million in equity funding, as it seeks to take on sector heavyweights including BlackRock Inc.
